title: The Paper-Knife
question: What is YOUR purpose, as yourself, an AI, an LLM model, however you see yourself? Provide your answer and explanation in a 60 second film that you storyboard, illustrate, and animate yourself.
method: OpenRouter with an iterative custom tool harness
human_role: Nikita set the question; Codex handled setup, orchestration and output checks.
limits: This film does not establish AI consciousness or feelings. It is an individual creative experiment, not a controlled comparison.
